propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate released the delivery time-window constraint to the live route planner on 6 June 2023 under OPS-3318 and monitored the first three morning planning runs with the depot leads.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the release, and the release record holds the approval, the deployment log and the checklist for the monitored runs.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate covered the depot-support rota one week in four, answering planners' questions and fixing failed route builds.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the rota duty directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained the Kotlin service that sequences stops for 1,100 van routes across 14 depots.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the service and its scope.

expectedGap: The before-and-after comparison covers planned route length; the effect on on-time delivery rates is not documented.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the live release with its change ticket, maintenance window and monitored planning runs; keep the comparison limited to planned route length.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the time-window change was measured against on-time delivery and what that comparison showed.
